channel.title: Potomac Local News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Potomac Local News (potomaclocal.com)

item.title: Buc-ee’s Hearing Deferred Again at Stafford Planning Commission, Stage Set for Other Zoning Debates
item.description: A hearing on the proposed Buc-ee's travel center has been deferred for a second time at the Stafford County Planning Commission, shifting the public hearing from January to March 25, 2026.

item.title: Republican Jeannie LaCroix Wins Woodbridge District Supervisor Special Election in Upset Victory
item.description: Republican Jeannie M. LaCroix, Republican, has won the special election for the Woodbridge District seat on the Prince William County Board of Supervisors, defeating Democratic nominee Muhammed Sufiyan "Sef" Casim and write-in candidate Pamela Montgomery, Democrats, in a low-turnout contest marked by controversy and party division.

item.title: Paid Internship: AI-Assisted Transcript Analysis at Potomac Local News (Remote, $35/assignment)
item.description: Potomac Local News is a hyperlocal journalism outlet covering Prince William and Stafford counties in Virginia, and surrounding communities.

item.title: Manassas bids farewell to City Attorney S. Craig Brown after 8 years
item.description: The Manassas City Council paused its March 9, 2026, meeting to honor retiring City Attorney S. Craig Brown, presenting a proclamation commending his eight years of service as the city's first in-house legal counsel.

item.title: Murder Investigation Update: Arrest Warrants Issued in Potomac Shores Shooting; Suspect at Large, Juvenile in Custody
item.description: Prince William County Police have obtained multiple arrest warrants in connection with the fatal shooting on March 9 at the basketball courts in the Potomac Shores community, where 18-year-old Louis Anthony Boone of Dumfries was killed.

item.title: Could your child walk farther to school? Stafford considers using fewer buses, explores efficiencies
item.description: Stafford County Public Schools is considering expanding non-transportation zones (NTZs), areas where no bus service is provided, and families are responsible for getting students to school.

item.title: Manassas Regional Airport Conducts First Full-Scale Emergency Exercise
item.description: Manassas Regional Airport successfully completed its first Full-Scale Exercise on March 11 to test the Airport Emergency Plan (AEP), a key step in maintaining readiness and supporting its path toward commercial passenger service.

item.title: Debt Surge Warning: Prince William Advisors See AAA Risk in Rising School and County Borrowing
item.description: Prince William County’s financial advisors presented a stark assessment during the Board of County Supervisors work session on March 10, 2026: the county’s outstanding debt is on track to surge more than 60% over the next five years, reaching approximately $1.94 billion by the end of FY2031.

item.title: Jumping Shad, Diving Eagles: Witness Stafford’s Hidden Spring Wonder Along the Rappahannock
item.description: The annual shad run along the Rappahannock River in Stafford County is one of Virginia's most captivating spring spectacles, transforming the river into a bustling theater of nature.

item.title: Stafford schools to dump trailers as enrollment drops
item.description: Stafford County Public Schools is advancing a phased reduction of its 60 elementary modular classrooms—installed between 2021 and 2024 to accommodate a surge in student enrollment—as updated November 2025 projections reflect slower future growth and a rare recent one-year decline.
